class Solution:
    def maximumCoins(self, coins: List[List[int]], k: int) -> int:
        coins.sort()
        blocks_len = []
        blocks_w = []
        if not coins:
            return 0
        cur_pos = coins[0][0]
        for l, r, c in coins:
            if l > cur_pos:
                blocks_len.append(l - cur_pos)
                blocks_w.append(0)
            blocks_len.append(r - l + 1)
            blocks_w.append(c)
            cur_pos = r + 1
        n = len(blocks_len)
        i = 0
        left_offset = 0
        span = 0
        cur = 0
        ans = 0
        for j in range(n):
            add_len = blocks_len[j]
            cur += add_len * blocks_w[j]
            span += add_len
            while span > k:
                need = span - k
                avail = blocks_len[i] - left_offset
                take = avail if avail <= need else need
                cur -= take * blocks_w[i]
                left_offset += take
                span -= take
                if left_offset == blocks_len[i]:
                    i += 1
                    left_offset = 0
            if cur > ans:
                ans = cur
        return ans
